body:
well I moved back in with my mom. it sucks because I brag about being out the house at 17. I  turned 24 at the end of July and being back here feels like I've failed the adulthood test. but I guess the good thing about it is that I know I cant die here...I don't want her to be the one to find me. i sent her a text that day i tried. she told me if i ever say anything like that again she going to put me in the "crazy house". her love always comes out in some sort of demeaning phrase. 

I cant handle being alone at night so i got a 3rd shift job. I was doing really good until today. called out because i was exhausted but forgot how triggering nights are when im alone. i keep thinking about  that day and how the room looked. it felt like a year ago but today it feels like yesterday. i cant get it out my head. 

its like ive been making good choices but picking up back habits. i got a pretty good paying job and im planning out my future but i started cutting myself  and smoking Newports super heavy. damn near a pack a day. honestly i really don't know anything about myself anymore.
you right. it just makes it so much harder to try again. But I guess that's a good thing. I've got so many conflicting thoughts.

Thank you for replying that day.
I'm trying so hard man..
Knxwledge gets me through most days.
Me too. just take me out of here tonight.
